channel.title: Daily Tech Opinions Digest
channel.description: Daily digest of tech opinions and blog posts from researchers and thinkers (RSS supplement)

item.title: Terence Tao: Hexagon — a new repository for LLM-assisted mathematics
item.description: Tao announces a new citable repository for research proved with LLM assistance, with lower authorship barriers than arXiv — he argues LLM-discovered results are too "brittle" to live on blogs or GitHub posts.

item.title: Andrew Ng: Scaling Up for Future AI Demands — More Agents Demand More Compute
item.description: Ng's latest letter argues most people still underestimate the data-center buildout required, as multiplying agents push compute demand far past current capacity plans.
